When Pluto opposes the South Node, a negotiation, boundary, ending, or high-stakes decision can put an old fear or control pattern directly across from what is happening now. You may feel pulled toward the strategy that once kept you from being vulnerable. The old lesson may still contain useful information. It should not have permanent authority over every new situation.
